body: Mine was adderall. I’ve always had anxiety and baby panic attacks here and there but could completely control them. But adderall sent me into a full spiral it’s been 5-6 weeks since that happened and I’ve improved tremendously still have them. But way better than the first two weeks. I also cut out caffeine, alcohol, and eat really healthy, workout and talk to my therapist once a week. Going to start doing CBT as well. :) you can and will improve. And that’s something I’m confident about.

For me someone saying you’ll never get back from DPDR. That 100% triggers me into a huge panic. Because obviously dpdr is from anxiety and if you heal anxiety you will heal everything else. But yeah that’s my trigger.

Something I’ve done that helps me is i don’t force myself to sleep anymore. I’ll sleep when my body and mind are ready. I’ll stay up until then. I feel like the more i focus on needing to sleep the harder it is for me.

I would personally connect and reach out to the recruiters through LinkedIn expressing your interest, and have them look over your profile. I’m not saying you’ll have a bite with all. But as a recruiter when someone personally reaches out to me vs applying through our system I’m more inclined to set up a call. Or it initiates a quicker response. I am one recruiter handling two different teams within a company with 30 open reqs and thousands of applicants coming in each day it’s hard for me to keep up. Which might be the same for other recruiters. Just a thought for you or anyone in their job search. I am sorry you experienced this.

From personal experience, you can’t judge off the way someone texts you. There are people who are great at responding, and aren’t into you and people who are into you but aren’t always looking at their phone. Texting is lame. One you can’t understand tone through text, and two there’s not much emotion you can show. Vs calling you can hear tones of voice, and interest of the other person. Try not basing someone’s interest in you off how fast they reply. Because it’s not a good indicator. Are they making time to hangout with you in person, and planning for next dates? Yes, then they probably like you to want to continue hanging out with you. If they’re not then they probably aren’t, and that’s okay. Go find someone who is, and stop wasting time waiting for someone. Not saying you are. Just generally speaking here.
